name: golf-swing
description: Golf Swing Tempo Trainer — measure your backswing-to-downswing tempo and track your sessions.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @golf-swing/server" "npm run dev -w @golf-swing/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @golf-swing/server && npm run build -w @golf-swing/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @golf-swing/server && npm run typecheck -w @golf-swing/web
